root_cause.text: The error unwind path in mana_ib_create_qp_rss() fails to call mana_disable_vport_rx() to clean up the vport steering configuration established by mana_ib_cfg_vport_steering(), resulting in a resource leak when later copy to udata fails.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a new label `err_disable_vport_rx` that invokes `mana_disable_vport_rx(mpc)` before falling through to the existing `fail:` label, fixing the leak by ensuring the steering configuration is undone on that error path. The CVE description states: "Sashiko points out that mana_ib_cfg_vport_steering() is leaked".
